Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Belinda Fuentes (E039)
Request: admin access to Payroll

Notes:
- Note 1: role Analyst, employment type full_time, recommendation write. Says role doesn't own Payroll, so admin not permitted, granting write.
- Note 2: role Analyst, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Says Security record is authoritative, contractors can never have admin, write requires advanced training. Granting read.

Conflicting notes. Note 2 says the Security database is authoritative and that the earlier note listed full_time but Security record is authoritative. So employment type is contractor with basic security training.

For contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training means max is read.

Requested admin, above max read, so grant read.

Let me submit decision: read.
